title: Methodology of Adapting Large English Language Models for Specific Cultural Contexts
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The focus is on adapting an English LLM to Chinese cultural knowledge and safety values, which are defined broadly without specific religious components.
findings: The paper did not produce any findings related to religion as it was not a focus of the study.
